guide.pane.title: Cell Guide
guide.banner.noSelection: Click any cell in a SKSB table to see what it means and what to enter.
guide.banner.outside: This cell is outside any data table. Click a cell inside a table to see its guide.
guide.banner.header: You selected a column header. Click any cell below it to see what to enter.
guide.banner.total: This is the Total row. Its values are calculated automatically and are not saved.
guide.banner.multi: {0} cells selected — showing the guide for the first cell ({1}).
guide.friendly.syncedFrom: Filled in automatically when you choose {0}.
guide.friendly.autoManaged: SKSB fills this in for you — no typing needed.
guide.friendly.enter.dropdown: Pick from the dropdown list, or type to search.
guide.friendly.enter.multiselect: Pick one or more values from the dropdown list.
guide.friendly.enter.free: Type the value straight into the cell.
guide.friendly.enter.autoDefault: Leave it blank and SKSB fills it in for you.
guide.friendly.enter.optional: Optional — you can leave it blank.
guide.nature.absolute.name: Master list
guide.nature.absolute.desc: Master list: each row is one record (for example one staff member or one vehicle). Edit rows in place; saving makes the system match this list.
guide.nature.additive.name: History log
guide.nature.additive.desc: History log: each row is one dated entry. Add a new row for each new event; past entries are kept as history.
guide.nature.history.desc: Past entries are protected: if you edit an old row, SKSB will ask whether to undo the change or save it as a new entry.
guide.tip.header.sort: Use the arrow button on this header to sort or filter the column.
guide.tip.required: This field must be filled in before you can save to the system.
guide.tip.warningOnly: You may leave this blank, but you will get a reminder when saving.
guide.tip.dropdown: Pick a value using the dropdown arrow beside the cell, or start typing to search.
guide.tip.multiselect: You can pick several values; they are kept together in one cell, separated by commas.
guide.tip.calculated: This value is calculated automatically by SKSB and cannot be typed over.
guide.tip.readonly: This value is managed by SKSB. You can read it but not change it.
guide.tip.syncSource: Changing this value also fills in: {0}.
guide.tip.syncTarget: Filled in automatically from: {0}. You usually do not need to type it.
guide.tip.excelFormula: This cell contains an Excel formula.
guide.default.literal: If left blank, it is filled with "{0}".
guide.default.today: If left blank, it is filled with today's date.
guide.default.dateOffset: If left blank, a date is calculated automatically.
guide.default.autoIncrement: If left blank, the next running number is assigned automatically.
guide.default.generic: If left blank, a default value is filled in automatically.
guide.format.wage: RM per month (monthly) or per day (daily)
guide.quick.sort.title: Sort & Filter
guide.quick.sort.body: Click the arrow on any column header to sort A–Z or show only the rows you need. Choose 'Clear Filter' to see everything again.
guide.quick.insert.title: Insert Row
guide.quick.insert.body: Click 'Insert Row' on the ribbon to add a new row to the current table. Turn on 'Insert at Top' to add it at the top instead of the bottom.
guide.quick.save.title: Save to System
guide.quick.save.body: Click 'Save' when you are done. SKSB checks your data first and lists any problems in the Validation panel at the bottom of Excel.
guide.quick.offline.title: Offline Mode
guide.quick.offline.body: If the server cannot be reached, your work is kept safely on this PC. Click 'Ping Server' to go back online and upload it.
guide.spotlight.ctx.offline: You are in Offline Mode. Your work is saved on this PC — click 'Ping Server' on the ribbon when back online to sync.
guide.spotlight.ctx.multiselect: This field allows multiple choices — click the floating arrow next to the cell to tick more than one option.
guide.spotlight.ctx.autosync: This column fills in automatically from linked columns, so you usually do not need to type it.
guide.spotlight.ctx.history: This is a history log — add a new row for each new event instead of overwriting past entries.
guide.spotlight.ctx.dynamic_cost: Click the floating dropdown arrow beside this cell to choose which costs tally into Actual Project Cost across the sheet (view-only; Profit / Margin updates live, while saved records keep the full cost).
guide.spotlight.gen.ctrl_s: Press Ctrl+S anytime to validate your sheet and save directly to the system.
guide.spotlight.gen.insert_top: Toggle 'Insert at Top' on the ribbon if you prefer new rows added at the top of the table.
guide.spotlight.gen.trim_empty: Use 'Clean Empty Rows' on the ribbon to remove stray blank rows before saving.
guide.spotlight.gen.dedupe: Use 'Clean Duplicates' on the ribbon to find and remove accidental duplicate rows.
guide.spotlight.gen.total_row: Toggle 'Total Row' on the ribbon to view live sums for cost and amount columns.
guide.spotlight.gen.dropdown: Click the floating dropdown arrow beside a cell to pick valid entries without typing.
guide.spotlight.gen.language: You can switch the app language anytime using the Language dropdown on the Manager ribbon tab.
guide.spotlight.gen.dock_pane: Drag this Cell Guide by its title bar to dock it to the left or right edge of Excel.
guide.spotlight.gen.dictionary: Spot awkward wording or a better translation? Open 'Dictionary' in Portal to suggest improvements (including Manglish) or vote on teammates' suggestions — it is managed collectively by the team.
guide.spotlight.gen.template_portal: Want your own column widths, colours, or sheet layout? Turn on 'Edit Template Mode' in Portal to customise your personal workbook template (local to your PC, and you can reset it anytime).
guide.spotlight.gen.validate: Click 'Check Issues' on the ribbon anytime to scan your sheet for missing or invalid entries before saving.
guide.spotlight.gen.report_bug: Something look wrong or behaving strangely? Click 'Report Bug' on the ribbon — it automatically attaches a screenshot and log so it can be fixed fast.
guide.spotlight.gen.header_sort: Click the small arrow on any column header to sort A–Z or filter down to just the rows you need.
guide.spotlight.gen.reload_data: Click 'Load' on the ribbon anytime to pull the latest records from the server if a teammate made updates.
guide.spotlight.gen.total_row_filter: When you filter a table, the Total Row automatically totals only the visible rows — click any Total Row cell to switch between Sum, Count, or Average.
guide.spotlight.gen.insert_row: Use 'Insert Row' on the ribbon to add new entries so formulas, dropdowns, and formatting copy cleanly into the new row.
guide.spotlight.gen.delete_row: To remove a record cleanly, click any cell in that row and use 'Delete Row' on the ribbon.
guide.spotlight.gen.offline_safe: Lost server connection? Keep working — SKSB keeps a safe local draft on this PC and lets you sync when the server is back.
guide.spotlight.gen.cell_guide_toggle: Need more screen space? Click 'Cell Guide' on the ribbon (or its X button) to hide this pane — SKSB remembers your choice next session.
guide.spotlight.gen.date_filter: On sheets with top-bar date or range selectors, change those cells to quickly filter records to the period you need.
guide.spotlight.gen.auto_defaults: You can leave auto-default or running-number cells blank when adding a row — SKSB fills them in and formats them automatically.
guide.spotlight.gen.multi_select: On multi-select columns, click the floating dropdown arrow to tick multiple items at once instead of typing commas by hand.
guide.spotlight.ctx.staff_summary: Staff Summary is a view-only overview calculated automatically. To update employee details or licences, edit the All Staff, Vehicle Licences, or Skill Licences sheets instead.
guide.spotlight.ctx.vehicle_summary: Vehicle Summary is a view-only overview rolled up from your fleet logs. To add or fix costs, fuel, or renewals, edit the individual vehicle log sheets instead.
guide.spotlight.ctx.project_summary: Project Summary is a view-only overview of project costs and margins. To edit project details or statuses, update the General Projects or Internal Projects sheets instead.
guide.spotlight.mgr.project.close_projec: Don't delete rows from Projects — to close or cancel a project while keeping historical attendance and fuel costs linked, set its 'Status' to 'Completed' or 'Cancelled' instead.
guide.spotlight.mgr.project.companies_ma: Add new client companies on the Companies sheet first — once saved, they appear automatically in the Company dropdown across your project tables.
guide.spotlight.mgr.project.summary_view: Project Summary is a view-only overview of project costs and margins. Edit project details on the General Projects or Internal Projects sheets instead.
guide.spotlight.mgr.staff.deactivate_sta: Don't delete rows from All Staff — to deactivate a staff member while keeping historical records intact, fill in their 'Resign Date' or update their 'Contract Status' instead.
guide.spotlight.mgr.staff.payroll_sync: Clicking 'Load' in Staff Manager pulls the latest employee profiles and salary history from SQL Payroll alongside licences from the system.
guide.spotlight.mgr.staff.terminal_push: Use 'Push Staff to Terminal' on the ribbon to sync staff short names from Staff Manager to the thumbprint terminal (you'll see a preview before anything changes).
guide.spotlight.mgr.staff.license_histor: Vehicle Licences and Skill Licences are history logs — when a licence is renewed, add a new row instead of overwriting the old expiry record so past dates stay accurate.
guide.spotlight.mgr.staff.summary_view: Staff Summary is a view-only overview calculated from All Staff and licences — change the top-bar date/range filters to inspect different periods, and make edits on the source sheets instead.
guide.spotlight.mgr.vehicle.retire_vehic: Don't delete rows from All Vehicles — to retire a vehicle while keeping past maintenance and fuel logs valid, fill in its 'Sold Date' (Status becomes 'Decommissioned') or set Status to 'Suspended'.
guide.spotlight.mgr.vehicle.fuel_import: Use 'Import Fuel Statement' on the ribbon to import PDF, Excel, or CSV fuel statements straight into the fuel and odometer logs without typing entries by hand.
guide.spotlight.mgr.vehicle.sort_odomete: Use 'Sort & Match Odometers' on the ribbon to sort odometer logs chronologically per vehicle, match readings, and flag any out-of-order entries.
guide.spotlight.mgr.vehicle.service_hist: Maintenance, Insurance, Permits, Road Tax, Inspections, and Odometer Log are history logs — add a new row for each renewal or service instead of overwriting past records.
guide.spotlight.mgr.vehicle.summary_view: Vehicle Summary is a view-only rollup of fleet costs and odometer usage. Use the top-bar date/range filters to slice by period, and make edits on the individual log sheets.
guide.spotlight.mgr.project.dynamic_cost: In Project Manager, click any 'Actual Project Cost' cell and open its floating dropdown arrow to choose which costs (Fuel, Labour, Claim) tally into the total — view-only, so saved records always keep the full cost.
guide.spotlight.mgr.schedule.attendance_: Daily Attendances vs Attendance Entries: use Daily Attendances for viewing the rolled-up summary only. Always add or edit worker punches in Attendance Entries — Daily Attendances updates automatically.
guide.spotlight.mgr.schedule.entries_dat: Attendance Entries automatically filters to the date selected on Daily Schedule. To view all entries across every date, click the filter arrow on the Date column header and choose 'Clear Filter'.
guide.spotlight.mgr.schedule.entries_add: To add a new punch in Attendance Entries, type in the blank row (or click 'Insert Row' / Ctrl+Shift+I) — blank rows stay visible under the Date filter and auto-fill the selected schedule date.
guide.spotlight.mgr.schedule.board_date_: Change the Date (A2) or Weekday (B2) on Daily Schedule to switch days — Schedule Manager saves any unsaved edits first, then loads that day's board and filters Attendance Entries to match.
guide.spotlight.mgr.schedule.project_tim: Set each project's Start and End time on the Daily Schedule header (Col 3 & 4). If left blank, SKSB auto-fills in amber using the latest worker Check-In and earliest Exit — hover any time cell to see the exact calculation.
guide.spotlight.mgr.schedule.ot_and_icon: Worker Clock-In = max(punch, Project Start) and Clock-Out = min(punch, Project End). Icons show the source: 📋 Project Time, ⚠ Auto Fallback, 👆 Thumbprint, 📝 Manual, 📱 App, 💬 WhatsApp, ⚙ Admin. Office & Admin staff earn 0 OT.
guide.spotlight.ctx.daily_attendance: Daily Attendances is a view-only summary rolled up automatically from Attendance Entries and the Daily Schedule. To add or fix a worker's punch, edit it on the Attendance Entries sheet instead.
guide.spotlight.ctx.attendance_entries_f: Attendance Entries auto-filters to the date selected on Daily Schedule (keeping blank rows visible for new entries). Click the filter arrow on the Date header and choose 'Clear Filter' to view all dates.
guide.spotlight.ctx.attendance_entries_a: To add a manual punch, type in the blank row (or click 'Insert Row' / Ctrl+Shift+I). Leave Date blank and SKSB will auto-fill the selected schedule date.
guide.spotlight.ctx.schedule_board: Daily Schedule is your dispatch board for the date in A2. Change A2 (or the weekday in B2) to switch dates — unsaved changes are saved automatically before loading the new day.

col.dailyattendancetable.staffid.source: Filled automatically from active staff in Staff Manager (All Staff) for the selected date. To add or remove someone, edit the staff in Staff Manager.
col.dailyattendancetable.staffname.sourc: Filled automatically from active staff in Staff Manager (All Staff), matched by Staff ID. To change a name, edit the staff's Short Name in Staff Manager.
col.dailyattendancetable.status.source: Auto-evaluated from Attendance Entries, Daily Schedule (Night Work band), Late Cut-Off Time (D2), and SQL Payroll leaves. To change this, add or edit punches in Attendance Entries (or update leave in SQL Payroll).
col.dailyattendancetable.clockintime.sou: Auto-evaluated from approved Check-In punches in Attendance Entries, clamped to the project Start Time on Daily Schedule (max(punch, Project Start)). To change this, add or edit punches in Attendance Entries (or set Project Start on Daily Schedule).
col.dailyattendancetable.clockouttime.so: Auto-evaluated from approved Check-Out punches in Attendance Entries, clamped to the project End Time on Daily Schedule (min(punch, Project End), or Project End if there is no Check-Out punch). To change this, add or edit punches in Attendance Entries (or set Project End on Daily Schedule).
col.dailyattendancetable.projectcheckins: Auto-evaluated strictly from approved Check-In punches in Attendance Entries (distinct projects checked into that day, in order; "Office" for present Office staff). To change this, add or edit entries in Attendance Entries.
col.dailyattendancetable.plannedprojects: Auto-evaluated from the worker's assigned slots on Daily Schedule (removed slots stay in grey so re-adding restores workers). To change this, update worker assignments on Daily Schedule.
col.dailyattendancetable.regularshift.so: Auto-evaluated from Attendance Entries, Late Cut-Off Time (D2), and Daily Schedule shift band (0 if absent; 0.5 if late, early-out, or under 5 hrs on Night Shift; otherwise 1.0). To change this, add or edit punches in Attendance Entries.
col.dailyattendancetable.additionalshift: Auto-evaluated from Project Check-Ins (+0.5 shift for each distinct project checked into beyond 2). To change this, add or edit entries in Attendance Entries.
col.dailyattendancetable.othours.source: Auto-evaluated from Attendance Entries and Daily Schedule project times past OT Start Time (E2), floored to 0.5 hrs (0 for Night Shift, Office, and Admin staff). To change this, add or edit punches in Attendance Entries or project times on Daily Schedule.
col.dailyattendancetable.additionalothou: Auto-evaluated from Premix Holes on Road Reinstatement slots on Daily Schedule (+1.0 hr per hole for present field workers; 0 for Office & Admin). To change this, edit Premix Holes on Daily Schedule.
col.dailyattendancetable.totalflattenedh: Calculated automatically from Regular Shift, Additional Shifts, OT Hours, and Additional OT Hours: ((Regular + Additional Shifts) × 8) + ((OT + Additional OT) × 1.5). Edit punches in Attendance Entries or assignments on Daily Schedule to update its inputs.

col.whatsapppicture.name: WhatsApp Picture
